then.say: Don't! Don't... oh. You're not one of them. You've got a face.
I slipped off the carts. Everyone else stayed on. I've been hiding here with the candles. They keep the drowned ones away, mostly.
The singing lady comes out at night. She calls them all her little ones. She called me too. I didn't go.

else.say: Are you going to take me somewhere? Somewhere with a fire?

menu.text: Go to Wick's Rest. There's a fire and a shrine.

do.say: A real fire? Up the hill? I know the way the carts came down. I'll follow them back up.
Don't let her sing to you. If she sings, don't listen.

toast: Pip has gone ahead to Wick's Rest.

do.say: Okay. I'm good at hiding. I'm very good.
